source_doc.title: Sivers Photonics receives $1m order from Ayar Labs (Semiconductor Today, July 3, 2023)
source_doc.permission_basis: Third-party trade publication (Semiconductor Today, Juno Publishing and Media Solutions Ltd); copyrighted editorial. Repository retains only the canonical URL, limited verbatim excerpts needed for evidence, and derived research — not the full article text.

sources.quote: Sivers Photonics of Glasgow, Scotland, UK has received a new order worth $1m
DFB laser arrays provide the high-quality light source for Ayar Labs' SuperNova remote optical source product

claims.statement: Independent trade-press (Semiconductor Today, 2023-07-03) reports Sivers Photonics received a $1m order and that its DFB laser arrays provide the light source for Ayar Labs' SuperNova — a non-Sivers, non-aleabitoreddit origin corroborating the Sivers→Ayar Labs supply relationship as a concrete commercial order rather than a customer-map inference.
claims.disproof_condition: If Ayar Labs publicly qualifies an alternative DFB laser-array supplier for SuperNova, or Sivers discloses loss of the Ayar program, downgrade.
